question_en: List the most recently submitted TDocs targeting Rel-18 (contribution status by release).
original_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}) MATCH (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10
reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}) MATCH (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

required_fields.name: tdocNumber
required_fields.semantic_role: Identity of each requested recently submitted Rel-18 TDoc in the original Phase1 meeting-register retrieval context.
